rows.grounds: causative verb directing performance of a ritual act
compound object naming the fire offering according to the saṃhitā
qualifies the ritual act as intense or formidable
prescribes recitation as the alternative act
indicates the alternative is performed in the same manner or context

items.question: What ritual alternatives are prescribed for initiated Śiva devotees following the prescribed bathing?
premises: The context prescribes ritual action after bathing initiated Śiva devotees.
One option is to have a fierce saṃhitā fire offering performed.
Another option is to perform recitation likewise.
items.inference: After the prescribed bathing, the officiant may either arrange a fierce saṃhitā fire offering or perform recitation as an equivalent alternative.
uncertainties: The exact referent and character of the fierce recitation implied by ghoraṃ with japet is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One should have a fierce saṃhitā fire offering performed, or likewise should recite.
